policy_class.gamma_zero_role: audit endpoint; economically artificial because residual inventory is mechanically settled after H

data_use_order.TRAIN: fit/freeze environment; construct asset-specific P_Theta; numerical convergence; select gamma within each objective and asset
data_use_order.VALIDATION: one confirmation of TRAIN-selected numerical/policy choices; no retuning
data_use_order.TEST: access once after design lock; final OOS reliability evaluation only

common_random_numbers.scope: within each asset x seed x outer-design cell, reuse identical outer theta atoms and conditional replay seeds across every gamma and comparable objective
common_random_numbers.purpose: reduce Monte Carlo noise in policy/objective comparisons without changing marginal laws

localized_KL_radius.selection_rule: No epsilon is selected by minimizing TEST loss. Report the full predeclared sensitivity grid. A primary radius may be designated only by an ex-ante TRAIN calibration rule documented before VALIDATION/TEST.
localized_KL_radius.same_numeric_epsilon_across_assets_inter: sensitivity comparison only; not empirical equivalence of ambiguity size
localized_KL_radius.matched_global_delta_rule: delta=epsilon may be used only as a matched-budget containment comparison under the same factorized cost law; not as calibration equivalence

inner_convergence.gate_metric: relative change of localized rho between the two largest common balanced L values
inner_convergence.rule: Use common balanced prefixes. Targeted allocation may improve precision after the balanced gate, but cannot by itself certify convergence.

outer_convergence.gate_metric: relative change of localized rho between the two largest nested M values using common nested outer prefixes
outer_convergence.rule: M convergence is assessed separately for each asset; failure for either asset blocks final policy selection for that asset.

seeds.seed_role: independent replication layer; CRN is maintained across gamma within a seed
